description: Repairs r-cursor-1b/option-join-addnew-delete: all three Options variants shared one database, so later variants started from earlier mutations (P2 ID 3 already existed, C2 ID 1 already deleted) and could not be compared. P2 (1,10),(2,20) and C2 (1,1,'a'),(2,1,'b'),(3,2,'c') with a declared relationship C2.PID to P2.ID; this probe has its own copy and uses the Options value omitted only. On a fresh dynaset over "SELECT P2.ID AS PID, P2.N AS PN, C2.ID AS CID, C2.V AS CV FROM P2 INNER JOIN C2 ON P2.ID = C2.PID ORDER BY C2.ID" with held Fields PID, PN, CID and CV: P2 and C2 are read through snapshots (the baseline); (a) AddNew, assign PID 3 and PN 30, Update, Errors, then the base tables are read; (b) AddNew, assign CID 10 and CV 'n' only, Update, Errors, then the base tables; (c) AddNew, assign PID 1, CID 11 and CV 'm', Update, Errors, then the base tables; (d) MoveFirst, Delete, Errors, EditMode, BOF, EOF, then the base tables. Asks which base row an AddNew or Delete on a join touches, the effect of the option and of the declared relationship, and the rows left in each base table after every step. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
